title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S03 E04 — Burton Mossman Crosses the Line
After failing to capture ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border; in Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S03 E06 — Sister Blandina and the Killer
While serving as a missionary in the West, Sister Blandina bravely thwarts an angry mob intent on hanging a man accused of attempted murder.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S01 E03 — Jim Beckwourth: War Chief of the Crow
In an epic tale of adventure, former slave Jim Beckwourth goes West to work as a trapper only to become a battle-hardened war chief of the Crow; when a conflict with mountain men leads to violence, he must choose between the two worlds he loves.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S05 E08 — Kiddie Corral
After a cattle deal falls through, the cowboys decide to auction off the unwanted cattle; Bubba asks Booger to baby-sit Andie, so he can take Kaley on a romantic getaway; Cody tries to find the perfect announcer for his rodeo.
